response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with __3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) and/or 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises __two or more different__ OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate __derived from an aliphatic diisocyanate and modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) and/or 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES)__.

4. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Original) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Original) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is __at least 31.0 dynes/cm__.

8. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating, __measured as root mean square (RMS) roughness, is greater than 200 nm__.
